description: Schema for raidjit offline benchmark result files. Version tolerance is a first-class requirement: every file declares its schema version and the raidjit version that produced it; ingestion migrates or quarantines as needed.

plan_id.description: Opaque plan identifier. Only comparable within the same planid_format_version.

static.description: Static-model figures. Only comparable within the same static_model_version.

twins.description: Twin names. Only comparable within the same twin_set_version AND config_space_version.

code_hash.description: SHA-256 of the generated machine code bytes (hex, lowercase). GROUND TRUTH for kernel identity: two measurements are of the same kernel only if code_hash matches. Same config + different code_hash across raidjit versions = codegen changed (not comparable as same kernel, but the delta is interesting). Same config + same raidjit_version + different code_hash = nondeterminism BUG (flag immediately).

code_size.description: Size of the generated machine code in bytes. Must be consistent with code_hash (same bytes hashed).

config_space_version.description: Version of the config-space validity rules under which this candidate was legal (see bench/config_space/VERSIONS.md). A twin/ISA/option legal in v1 but retired in v2 keeps its v1 tag; queries must be version-aware and never silently merge across a config-space break.

plan_kind.description: Plan kind: xor, mulacc, horner, delta. Used for config grouping and drift detection.

failed.description: For recover: indices of failed disks. Omitted for encode.

format_version.description: Opaque format tag, e.g. 'bench-result/1'. Changed only on breaking reorganization of the file layout.

protocol.description: How the measurement was taken. Forward-compatible: unknown keys ignored.

provenance.description: Version context needed to interpret this result soundly across raidjit versions. Semantic drift (plan IDs, twins, cost model) is tracked per-axis so aggregation can decide comparability per-axis instead of rejecting whole files.

bench_protocol_version.description: Version of the bench_select protocol. Measured GB/s are only comparable when protocol version AND sizes match.

planid_format_version.description: Version of the plan-ID grammar. Plan IDs are only comparable when this matches; a mismatch quarantines the plan_id field (other fields may still aggregate).

raidjit_version.description: Git SHA (full or abbreviated) of the raidjit tree that produced this result. 'unknown' if not recorded (legacy).

static_model_version.description: Version of the static cost model (uops/byte etc.). Static figures are only comparable when this matches.

twin_set_version.description: Version of the twin enumeration (RJ_TWIN_* list). Twin names are only comparable when this matches; a new twin added is a MINOR bump, a twin removed/renamed is MAJOR.

config_space_version.description: Version of the config-space validity rules (which twins x ISAs x plan kinds are legal). Bumped on ANY gate change. See bench/config_space/VERSIONS.md.

schema_version.description: Version of THIS schema document. Ingestion migrates v1..N forward; unknown future versions are quarantined, never crashed on.

topology.description: Topology descriptor, e.g. 'rs(6,3)', 'raid5(4+1)'. Interpreted per planid_format_version.

title: raidjit benchmark result
